run-gates.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,sys,time
root=Path.cwd(); scratch=root/'.wac-local/WAC-M3-02'; evidence=root/'docs/codex/winaudioclean/evidence'
phase=sys.argv[1]; label=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'final'
assert phase in ('Targeted','Full') and re.fullmatch('[a-z0-9-]+',label)
names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
names=sorted(set(n for n in names if n.endswith(('.ps1','.psd1','.py','.cs','.bat')) and (root/n).is_file()))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source={n:sha(root/n) for n in names}
def sanitize(text):
 text=re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]','',text)
 for old,new in ((str(root),'<repo>'),(root.as_posix(),'<repo>'),(str(Path.home()),'<user-profile>'),(Path.home().as_posix(),'<user-profile>')):
  text=re.sub(re.escape(old),lambda m:new,text,flags=re.I)
 return '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()).rstrip()+'\n'
def run(shell):
 exe=shutil.which(shell);assert exe
 host='ps51' if shell=='powershell.exe' else 'ps7'
 statement='./scripts/Invoke-Tests.ps1 -Level '+phase
 if phase=='Targeted': statement+=" -Path @('tests/WinAudioClean.Launcher.Tests.ps1')"
 if phase=='Full' and host=='ps7':statement+=' -AnalyzerWarnings'
 command=[exe,'-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command',statement]
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.upper()!='PSMODULEPATH'};start=time.time()
 p=subprocess.run(command,env=env,cwd=root,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=2400)
 log=evidence/('WAC-M3-02-'+phase.lower()+'-'+label+'-'+host+'.txt')
 assert not log.exists(),'Refusing to overwrite prior gate evidence.'
 log.write_text(sanitize(p.stdout),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
 r={'shell':host,'phase':phase,'label':label,'command':[sanitize(a).strip() for a in command],'exit_code':p.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.time()-start,2),'log':log.relative_to(evidence.parent).as_posix(),'log_sha256':sha(log)}
 print(json.dumps(r),flush=True);print('\n'.join(sanitize(p.stdout).splitlines()[-10:]),flush=True);return r
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:runs=list(pool.map(run,['powershell.exe','pwsh.exe']))
unchanged=source=={n:sha(root/n) for n in names}
metadata=scratch/(phase.lower()+'-'+label+'-results.json');assert not metadata.exists()
metadata.write_text(json.dumps({'source':source,'source_unchanged':unchanged,'runs':runs},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(0 if unchanged and all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in runs) else 1)
